content: Character reference sheet, photoreal, neutral flat overcast studio light on a plain concrete-grey background. A heavy-set man in his late thirties, ex-demolition crew, shaved head, broken nose, grey work trousers, torn hi-vis vest over bare arms, steel-toe boots. Four views on one sheet: front, three-quarter, side, and back. On the right of the sheet, the same man in his accreted state - rough concrete plates locked over his forearms, shoulders and back, iron-oxide rust-orange rebar showing through the seams, face still fully human and visible. No costume, no emblem, no cape, no mask. No existing superhero characters. Photoreal, 35mm grain, no stylisation, no text on the sheet.
